connector.name: SSH MCP Tool
connector.registryDescription: Secure MCP SSH automation server with policy controls, resources, prompts, stdio, and HTTP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-ssh-tool. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oaslananka account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SSH_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins for Streamable HTTP clients. Keep this restricted when not using loopback.

env.name: SSH_MCP_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN_FILE
env.description: Path to a bearer token file. Required for non-loopback HTTP bindings.

env.name: SSH_MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Stable HTTPS public /mcp URL. Required for non-loopback HTTP bindings.

env.name: SSH_MCP_HTTP_TRUST_PROXY
env.description: Set to true only behind a trusted reverse proxy that controls forwarded headers.
